events.title: Worsening hunger could push millions closer to famine in 13 global hotspots
events.summary: Millions of people across some of the world’s most vulnerable regions are expected to face worsening hunger in the months ahead, as conflict, economic pressures and shrinking aid budgets exacerbate long-running crises.

events.title: Lebanon: 12 children killed, maimed daily, despite Hezbollah-Israel truce
events.summary: More than 100 days of war reveals a shattering snapshot of life for civilians in Lebanon amid Israeli strikes and forced displacement, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) reported on Wednesday.

events.title: Security Council LIVE: Open debate on women, peace and security

events.title: A turning point for Haiti? New security force takes fight to powerful gangs
events.summary: Passengers look out of the back of a brightly-coloured shared pick-up style taxi, known locally in Haiti as a “tap tap” as it makes its way along the Boulevard du 15 Octobre in the east of the capital, Port-au-Prince.

events.title: UN officials call for urgent action in Yemen to push peace, reduce hunger
events.summary: Top UN officials called for bolstered efforts to stave off rising hunger and foster a path towards permanent peace in Yemen as they briefed the Security Council Tuesday morning.

events.title: ‘Some question if Ebola is real’: how trust is central in fighting DRC outbreak
events.summary: In Ebola-stricken Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), winning the race against the disease requires earning the community’s trust first and foremost, humanitarians said on Tuesday.
